_comment: Optional hand-picked 'Top Picks' devotional items per religion, replacing the current 'most-downloaded result' auto-selection (which sometimes surfaces mismatched content, e.g. Buddhist chants under a Hindu 'Mantras' filter). Each entry needs the Internet Archive 'identifier' and a 'religion' (Hindu/Islam/Christian/Sikh/Buddhist). Leave 'items' empty until you're ready to curate.
